result.title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
result.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
result.summary: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 SituRecBench：在高保真 3D 购物场景中让前沿 VLM 以用户第一人称视角充当情景化推荐助手，通过多轮对话询问偏好、在环境中定位目标并引导用户前往，统一评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其实验暴露的「全局上下文与局部观测难以整合」及空间 grounding 失败，可供核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留视觉细节与实体位置、以及证据获取与停止决策的诊断线索，但不涉及 latent 推理机制本身。
